about: Zone travel (zones branch, D2 style). Doors: a field zone's entry door leads back to the previous zone, its far arch only to the next zone; a town gate leads to the act's first zone; a boss arena's forward arch is sealed until the boss falls, then leads to the next act's town (the last act leads home). Waypoints: one in every town plus the zones listed per act; walk within discoverRadius (tiles) or tap one to add it; the Waypoint panel lists only found ones by act. townPortal: castTime seconds; cooldown seconds (0 = none); scrolls null = free (a number = uses carried, refilled in town); interruptOnHit / cancelOnMove false = a hit or a step doesn't stop the cast. waypoints.townSpot / townPortal.townSpot = [x, y] tile spot in each town (open square north of the houses, on the way to the gate). All player-facing words are in 'text' (Koto pass pending).

text.sealedToast: The way is sealed. Defeat {boss} first.
text.wpIntro: Tap a waypoint to travel there. Find more by walking up to them.
text.wpNone: No waypoints found in this act yet.
text.wpShut: You have not found that waypoint yet.
text.tpCooldown: Town Portal is not ready yet.
text.tpNoScroll: You have no Town Portal scrolls.
text.tpRift: Town Portal does not work inside a rift.
